title: Registry entry
description: What the author of a pull request asserts. Everything that can be checked is derived from the platform's own documents by the continuous check, never taken from this file.

origin.description: Scheme and host only, no path and no trailing slash.

reachability.description: public: the service document is served openly. gated: the host resolves but the document requires a credential. private: not reachable from the internet at all. A private platform is listed on the same terms as any other; reachability is a property of a deployment, never of conformance.

tools.description: Binding ids this platform publishes profiles for.

listed_by.description: The handle opening the pull request.
